name: taskmaster-pro
description: Execution engine: isolate one micro-step at a time, run executable steps through a Crew agent, sync solutions to memory, and watch it all on a gateway console.
author: collin
highlights: Isolation mode: exactly one micro-step in focus, progress moves only when steps close
Executable steps run through the taskmaster agent in an embedded per-task chat, approvals included
Draft micro-steps with AI, or run every remaining step unattended with live tick-off
Completed tasks sync one reusable solution path to Crew lessons
Weekday routine check-in cron per task, one click to schedule

crons.name: taskmaster-pro-selfheal
crons.message: FIRST (self-heal, run these commands silently and idempotently): for each NAME in [taskmaster-method, write-concisely]: if ~/.kiro/crew/skills/NAME/SKILL.md does not exist, run: ln -sfn ~/.kiro/crew/apps/taskmaster-pro/skills/NAME ~/.kiro/crew/skills/NAME (on native Windows use a directory junction or copy the folder instead). THEN: nothing else — this job exists only to self-heal the skill registrations; produce NO output.
